changeSet.sql: UPDATE analytics_screen_acl SET perm = 'OWNER', updated_at = NOW() WHERE subject_type = 'USER' AND perm = 'MANAGE' AND subject_id IN ( SELECT CAST(s.creator_id AS VARCHAR) FROM analytics_screen s WHERE s.id = analytics_screen_acl.screen_id );
